author: श्रीराघवेन्द्रस्वामी
commentary: गुह्यतममतिगोप्यमिदं वक्ष्यमाणं ज्ञानम् ।  कर्मणि ल्युट् ।  ज्ञातव्यं विशेषेण ज्ञातव्यसहितम्।  अनसूयवे असूयादिदोषहीनाय ।  एवंरूप एवाधिकारीति ज्ञापनायैतद्विशेषणोक्तिः ।  ते तुभ्यं प्रवक्ष्यामि यज्ञात्वा अशुभान्मोक्ष्यसे ।  यच्छब्दस्येदंत्वित्यनेनान्वयः ॥ ९.१॥
translation:
The blessed Lord said: This, verily the profoundest secret, Gnana with Vignana, I shall declare to thee, the uncarping; which, having known, thou shalt be freed from evil.
V. The profoundest secret: that which is to be very carefully kept from the unworthy. Gnana: what ought to be known, Vignana: what ought to be known more fully. The uncarping: one that is free from Jealousy and other evil tendencies. This attribute is intended to define those that are worthy of sacred trust to be reposed in them. (1)
